official_source_findings: SEC describes Feed archives organized by filing day and daily indexes updated at night. Some late submissions are disseminated the next business day and appear in that business day index.
The documentation supplies useful directory context, but does not itself provide an exact target accession membership observation or original first-public timestamp.
observed_listing_findings: One complete 2007 Q3 JSON listing contains 63 archive names and no compact audit/membership filename. No inference is made about other quarters or unlisted resources.

frozen_protocol_constraints.required: Accession-specific public-time/day evidence with applicable semantic authority and source/version provenance.

decision: Do not automatically spend the three unattempted directory requests or substitute daily index filing-date rows for the missing clock evidence.
next_evidence_design_requirements: Assess an authentic target daily audit entry or exact archive member evidence, together with documentary dissemination-day meaning.
If larger archive acquisition is proposed, register exact representation, range, aggregate byte/request caps, target-only scanning, integrity checks and stop behavior before seeking approval.
Keep historical reference actions, security eligibility, independent factual QA and final analysis authorization as separate requirements.
